label: Street washing and sweeping
definition: Municipal road surface cleaning and dust suppressants to remove deposited road dust before traffic resuspends it
citation: Amato 2010 10.1016/j.scitotenv.2010.04.025 (sweeping water flushing and chemical suppressants are the measures against road dust resuspension) and Jeong 2025 10.1016/j.envpol.2025.126165 (regenerative sweepers generally ineffective, water spraying reduces on-road PM during sweeping, excess water raises it afterwards)

label: Super-emitter share of fleet
definition: Fraction of on-road vehicles whose real-world emission factors are several times the fleet median
citation: Jezek Brecelj 2025 10.5194/acp-25-9113-2025 (Lorentz curve analysis shows growing influence of super-emitters on total fleet emissions, targeting them could yield substantial reductions), distinct from D22 which counts vehicles below the standard on paper

label: Service station attendant exposure
definition: Breathing-zone benzene and MTBE of forecourt staff during refuelling shifts
citation: Jo 2001 10.1080/10473289.2001.10464339 (attendant breathing-zone MTBE and benzene significantly higher than drivers, p under 0.05, higher in summer), no existing X node covers forecourt workers
